i: i — O!, hail (the vocative interjection that opens each declaration)

m: m — in, from (preposition) · also "with" (instrument), "as" (m bnw "as the Bennu"), "on" (living on), "by"; im before a suffix (im·i, im·f, im·tn)

·n: ·n — we, us, our (1st person plural suffix pronoun; water sign with plural strokes)
ḥtp: ḥtp — to be content, at peace, to rest (verb); peace; offering (noun; m ḥtp "in peace")
·kwi: ·kwi — I (1st person singular ending of the stative: "I am …, I have …")
snsn: snsn — to smell, breathe (verb; reduplicated from sn "smell, kiss")
wꜥ: wꜥ — one; (as a noun) one (of), someone

imy: imy — who/which is in (the nisba of m "in"; plural imyw)
